stages.name: quantization
cmd:
import os, shutil, time, json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from auto_round import AutoRound

input_dir = '{model_path}'
output_dir = '{model_path}-W4A16-AutoRound'
calib = '{stage_build_calibration_bundle_merged_output_jsonl}'
tmp_out = output_dir + '.tmp'

print(f'Input: {input_dir}')
print(f'Output: {output_dir}')
print(f'Calibration: {calib}')

if Path(output_dir).exists() and (Path(output_dir) / '.DONE').exists():
    print('SKIP: Already completed'); exit(0)

if Path(tmp_out).exists(): shutil.rmtree(tmp_out)
Path(tmp_out).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

t0 = time.time()
ar = AutoRound(
    input_dir,
    scheme='W4A16',
    dataset=f'{calib}:text',
    device='cpu',
    device_map='cpu',
    trust_remote_code=True,
    batch_size=1,
    seqlen=512,
    nsamples=128,
    iters=100,
    seed=42,
)
ar.quantize_and_save(tmp_out, format='auto_round')
elapsed = time.time() - t0

for name in ['config.json','chat_template.jinja','generation_config.json','tokenizer.json','tokenizer.model','tokenizer_config.json','special_tokens_map.json','added_tokens.json']:
    src = Path(input_dir) / name
    dst = Path(tmp_out) / name
    if src.exists() and not dst.exists(): shutil.copy2(src, dst)

if Path(output_dir).exists(): shutil.rmtree(output_dir)
Path(tmp_out).rename(output_dir)

Path(output_dir, '.DONE').write_text(json.dumps({'stage': 'autoround_w4a16', 'model': 'Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603', 'elapsed_hours': elapsed/3600, 'completed_at': datetime.now().isoformat()}, indent=2))
print(f'DONE in {elapsed/3600:.2f}h: {output_dir}')
